SHIPPED: Full transcription reliability overhaul across 9 files

SIGNIFICANCE: Pipeline previously had zero escape from stuck 'Processing' state — no fallbacks, no timeouts, no watchdog

CHANGES:
1. pipeline-fatal-failure + no_speech_detected now call clearProgress() + clear watchdog
2. ProgressReporter::report_heartbeat() method added; TauriProgressReporter emits pipeline_heartbeat events
3. FileStrategy + FastStreamStrategy spawn heartbeat task (5s interval, child_token linked to pipeline)
4. Frontend 30s watchdog in event-listeners.ts — resets to error if no heartbeat during transcribing
5. DynamicTranscriber: FluidAudio error → automatic retry with Whisper (audio cloned ~4MB for 60s)
6. FluidAudio timeout: 120s → 30s; Whisper: spawn_blocking + tokio::timeout(max(60s, 3×audio_secs))
7. Overlay pill watchdog removed — store watchdog authoritative, overlay reacts to status_changed
8. transcription_ready clears errorMessage to prevent zombie error+success state
9. pipeline_completed skips banner if already in error state

ACCEPTED TRADEOFFS: Whisper thread leaks on timeout (can't cancel C code), audio.clone() always happens before FluidAudio

FILES: strategies/file_strategy.rs, fast_stream_strategy.rs, progress_reporter.rs, dynamic_transcriber.rs, backends/whisper.rs, event-listeners.ts, TranscriptionOverlay
